client.portfolio.title.note: FR-ONB-001b / FR-MDL-003: the firm's client portfolio at /clients — the screen a firm lands on, and the one a business reaches when it has no administration yet.

client.portfolio.count.note: Counted. Beside the heading, so a firm with many clients sees the size of the list before scrolling it.

client.portfolio.choose.nl: Kies de klant waarin u wilt werken.
client.portfolio.choose.en: Choose the client you want to work in.

client.portfolio.open.note: The action on a client card. 'Openen', not 'Wisselen': from this screen nothing is open yet, so there is nothing to switch away from.

client.portfolio.no_kvk.note: Placeholder where a client card would show its KvK number. A client created by a firm before the number is known is a real state, not an error.

client.portfolio.add.note: The secondary action beside a portfolio that already has clients in it.

client.portfolio.add_first.note: FR-ONB-001b names this one literally: 'an empty client portfolio with a single prominent "Add your first client" action'. The one primary action on the screen (D1).

client.portfolio.empty_title.note: FR-UX-004: an empty list teaches what belongs in it. The firm variant.

client.portfolio.empty_body.nl: Voeg uw eerste klant toe. Wij maken de administratie aan, met een rekeningschema dat past bij de rechtsvorm — u hoeft niets in te richten.
client.portfolio.empty_body.en: Add your first client. We create the administration for you, with a chart of accounts matching the legal form — there is nothing to set up.

client.portfolio.empty_title_business.note: The same screen reached by a self-managed business with no administration yet (Model B). It keeps its own books, so 'client' would be the wrong word for what is missing.

client.portfolio.empty_body_business.nl: Richt uw administratie in om bonnen vast te leggen en facturen te versturen.
client.portfolio.empty_body_business.en: Set up your books to start capturing receipts and sending invoices.

client.portfolio.add_administration.note: The Model B wording of the same action — see empty_title_business.

client.portfolio.no_matches_body.note: Follows client.switcher.no_matches, which already names the query. This is the way out: the search came up empty, the portfolio did not.
client.portfolio.no_matches_body.nl: Pas uw zoekopdracht aan, of voeg deze klant toe.
client.portfolio.no_matches_body.en: Adjust your search, or add this client.

client.switcher.dialog_label.note: Accessible name of the client switcher dialog (FR-FRM-000).

client.switcher.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search input. Names all three things it searches, because the KvK number is the one people do not expect to work.
client.switcher.search_label.nl: Zoek klanten op naam, handelsnaam of KvK-nummer
client.switcher.search_label.en: Search clients by name, trade name or KvK number

client.switcher.list_label.note: Accessible name of the results listbox.

client.switcher.no_matches.note: Empty result set. {query} is what the person typed, quoted, so it is clear the search — not the account — is what came up empty.

client.switcher.kvk.note: The KvK number beside a client's name. Identical in both because KvK is a statutory term that keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c) — 'Chamber of Commerce number' would leave an English-speaking owner unable to match what is on screen to what is on the paper in front of them. See glossary.json.

client.switcher.current.note: Marks the client the session already has open, so switching to it is visibly a no-op.

client.header.loading.note: FR-FRM-000a. Shown while GET /v1/switcher/active is still in flight — deliberately distinct from client.header.none_selected, which is only for a CONFIRMED absence of an active client. Showing 'no client selected' during this window would be a false negative at exactly the moment the requirement exists to prevent.

client.banner.working_in.note: Banner for a firm user with a client open (SCREENS.md, Accountant view).

client.header.none_selected.note: FR-FRM-000a. Shown instead of an empty header when the session is inside no client — a blank space is indistinguishable from a header that failed to load.

client.header.colour_ambiguous.note: FR-FRM-000a. Another client in this user's switcher carries the same colour marker, so the colour is not distinguishing and the name is what to read.
client.header.colour_ambiguous.nl: Een andere klant heeft dezelfde kleur — controleer de naam
client.header.colour_ambiguous.en: Another client shares this colour — check the name

client.todo.title.note: The firm home's heading (docs/firm-home/contract.md). Same words as the rail item.

client.todo.welcome.note: {date} is the previous sign-in date; {ago} is client.todo.days_ago or client.todo.today.
client.todo.welcome.nl: Welkom terug. U was voor het laatst ingelogd op {date}, {ago}.
client.todo.welcome.en: Welcome back. Your last sign-in was {date}, {ago}.

client.todo.review_button.note: The page's one primary action. Opens the review sheet; it never approves in one click (ADR-110).

client.todo.counts_label.note: Label and tooltip of the count strip. The counts cover every client the user can see, NOT the Mine/Everyone toggle below them, so the text says so.
client.todo.counts_label.nl: Al uw klanten in één oogopslag, ongeacht aan wie ze zijn toegewezen
client.todo.counts_label.en: All your clients at a glance, whoever they are assigned to

client.todo.count.needs_attention.note: The word beside the warning icon on the broken-feeds count, so the state is never carried by colour alone.

client.todo.chip.my_move.note: Clients where the next step is the accountant's: proposals, receipts to book, bank lines, BTW ready to review.

client.todo.chip.vat_not_filed.note: BTW stays BTW in English (glossary: keepDutch).

client.todo.assigned.me.note: The list toggle: clients assigned to me plus clients assigned to nobody yet (ADR-109).

client.todo.col.bank.note: Column of unmatched bank lines. The same word in both languages.

client.todo.row.months_behind.note: Shown only when the books are more than one month behind; words, never colour alone.

client.todo.row.capped_by_feed.note: booked_until was capped by the oldest bank-feed sync: the books cannot be called complete past the last day the bank told us about.

client.todo.row.none.note: Screen-reader text behind the dash shown for a zero count.

client.todo.due.days.note: Days until the BTW deadline, in a narrow table column. 'd' is the abbreviation in both languages.

client.todo.due.soon.note: Screen-reader text beside a deadline less than a week away; the visual cue is weight, not colour alone.

client.todo.keyboard_hint.nl: J / K om te bewegen · Enter om te openen · X om te selecteren
client.todo.keyboard_hint.en: J / K to move · Enter to open · X to select

client.todo.empty_title.note: FR-UX-004: the teaching empty state for a firm with no clients yet.
client.todo.empty_title.nl: Uw takenlijst begint bij een klant
client.todo.empty_title.en: Your to-do list starts with a client

client.todo.empty_body.nl: Zodra u een klant toevoegt, komt hier alles samen wat op u wacht: bonnen om te boeken, banktransacties om te koppelen en btw-aangiftes die eraan komen, voor al uw klanten tegelijk.
client.todo.empty_body.en: Once you add a client, everything waiting on you gathers here: receipts to book, bank lines to match and BTW returns coming up, across all your clients at once.

client.todo.list_empty_my_move.nl: Er wacht nu niets op u. Kijk bij ‘Wacht op klant’ wat nog openstaat.
client.todo.list_empty_my_move.en: Nothing is waiting on you right now. See ‘Waiting on client’ for what is still open.

client.todo.assign.failed.note: Followed by one line per client that could not be assigned, with the server's reason.

client.todo.snooze.reason_hint.nl: Uw collega's zien dit, bijvoorbeeld ‘Wacht op jaarcijfers’.
client.todo.snooze.reason_hint.en: Your colleagues see this, for example ‘Waiting for annual figures’.

client.todo.review.intro.note: ADR-110: a proposal is not a posting. Approving posts it through the ledger service; rejecting changes nothing in the books.
client.todo.review.intro.nl: Er wordt niets geboekt tot u het goedkeurt. Afwijzen laat de boekhouding ongemoeid.
client.todo.review.intro.en: Nothing is posted until you approve it. Rejecting leaves the books untouched.

client.todo.review.empty_body.nl: Er staan nu geen boekingsvoorstellen open.
client.todo.review.empty_body.en: There are no pending auto-bookings right now.

client.todo.panel_error.note: One panel failed; the rest of the page still works.
client.todo.panel_error.nl: Dit onderdeel kon niet worden geladen.
client.todo.panel_error.en: This panel could not be loaded.

client.todo.deadlines.bar_label.nl: {filed} van {total} ingediend, {ready} klaar om in te dienen, {review} te controleren, {progress} bezig, {open} niet begonnen
client.todo.deadlines.bar_label.en: {filed} of {total} filed, {ready} ready to file, {review} in review, {progress} in progress, {open} not started

client.todo.deadlines.none.nl: Geen termijnen in de komende weken.
client.todo.deadlines.none.en: No deadlines in the coming weeks.

client.questions.nav.note: FR-FRM-005: sidebar entry inside a client, for client and firm users alike.

client.questions.new.note: Firm users only: ask this client a question.

client.questions.empty.open_body_client.nl: Als uw boekhouder iets vraagt over uw administratie, staat dat hier.
client.questions.empty.open_body_client.en: When your accountant asks something about your books, it appears here.

client.questions.empty.open_body_firm.nl: Vragen die u deze klant stelt, en die van de klant aan u, staan hier.
client.questions.empty.open_body_firm.en: Questions you ask this client, and theirs to you, appear here.

client.questions.empty.resolved_body.nl: Een vraag komt hier te staan zodra die is afgerond.
client.questions.empty.resolved_body.en: A question moves here once it is resolved.

client.questions.awaiting.you.note: Whose move it is, from the reader's side: the reader's.

client.questions.author.client.note: A firm user reading a message the client wrote; {name} is the client's name.

client.questions.form.required.nl: Vul een onderwerp en uw vraag in.
client.questions.form.required.en: Fill in a subject and your question.

client.questions.error.resolved.note: 409 question_thread_resolved: someone resolved the thread while this person was writing.
client.questions.error.resolved.nl: Deze vraag is net afgerond en neemt geen antwoorden meer aan. Uw tekst staat nog in het vak; stel een nieuwe vraag als er nog iets onduidelijk is.
client.questions.error.resolved.en: This question has just been resolved, so it no longer takes replies. Your text is still in the box; ask a new question if something is still unclear.

client.questions.error.mismatch.note: 409 active_client_mismatch: another client was opened in this session, e.g. in another tab.
client.questions.error.mismatch.nl: Er is in deze sessie een andere klant geopend, misschien in een ander tabblad. Open deze klant opnieuw via de klantenlijst en probeer het nog eens.
client.questions.error.mismatch.en: Another client is open in this session, perhaps in another tab. Open this client again from the client list, then try once more.

client.questions.error.not_found.nl: Deze vraag staat niet in de administratie van deze klant. Misschien hoort ze bij een andere klant.
client.questions.error.not_found.en: This question is not in this client's books. It may belong to another client.

client.receipts.nav.note: Sidebar entry inside a client: bank payments that still need a receipt.

client.receipts.intro.nl: Deze betalingen staan op uw bankrekening, maar er is nog geen bon of factuur voor. Upload er een per betaling, dan kan uw boekhouder ze boeken.
client.receipts.intro.en: These payments are on your bank account, but there is no receipt or invoice for them yet. Upload one per payment so your accountant can book them.

client.receipts.empty_body.nl: Elke bankbetaling heeft een bon of factuur. Nieuwe betalingen zonder bon verschijnen hier.
client.receipts.empty_body.en: Every bank payment has a receipt or invoice. New payments without one will appear here.

client.receipts.status.note: The status word on every line of the list.

client.receipts.upload_for.note: Accessible name of the per-line upload button.

client.receipts.capture_hint.nl: Maak een foto of upload het bestand. Zodra de bon is verwerkt, verdwijnt de betaling van deze lijst.
client.receipts.capture_hint.en: Take a photo or upload the file. Once the receipt has been processed, the payment leaves this list.

client.todo.inbox.empty_body.nl: Als een klant op een van uw vragen antwoordt, verschijnt dat hier.
client.todo.inbox.empty_body.en: When a client answers one of your questions, it appears here.

client.todo.inbox.tab.firm.note: Threads where the client wrote last: the accountant's move.

client.todo.inbox.tab.client.note: The accountant's own questions the client has not answered yet.

client.todo.inbox.waiting_empty_body.nl: Een vraag die u een klant stelt, staat hier tot de klant antwoordt.
client.todo.inbox.waiting_empty_body.en: A question you ask a client stays here until they answer.

client.todo.review.remember.note: Wave 2 (ADR-113): per proposal group. Approving with this ticked makes one rule per client in the group.
client.todo.review.remember.nl: Dit voortaan altijd doen bij deze klanten
client.todo.review.remember.en: Always do this for these clients

client.todo.review.remember_hint.note: What a rule does (contract-wave2 decision 2), in one breath. {account} is code and name, e.g. '4500 Telefoon'.
client.todo.review.remember_hint.nl: Maakt per klant één regel. Daarna wordt een zekere match van een bankbetaling met een bestaande bon of factuur van {counterparty} zonder vragen geboekt op {account}. Nooit zonder document; intrekken kan onder Klantregels.
client.todo.review.remember_hint.en: Makes one rule per client. From then on, a certain match of a bank payment to an existing receipt or invoice from {counterparty} is booked to {account} without asking. Never without a document; retire it any time under Client rules.

client.todo.activity.rule_postings.note: 'Since you were away' line (ADR-113): bookings an approval rule made on its own.

client.todo.bulk.chase.note: Bulk bar (ADR-114). Opens a preview first; nothing is sent by this button.

client.todo.chase.intro.note: FR-NTF-004 spirit: the mail carries a count and a link, never amounts or counterparties.
client.todo.chase.intro.nl: Elke klant krijgt één e-mail met het aantal bankbetalingen waarvoor nog een bon nodig is, en een link naar de lijst in de app. Bedragen en leveranciers staan er niet in. Wie in de afgelopen 24 uur al een herinnering kreeg, wordt overgeslagen.
client.todo.chase.intro.en: Each client gets one e-mail saying how many bank payments still need a receipt, with a link to their list in the app. It names no amounts or suppliers. A client reminded in the last 24 hours is skipped.

client.todo.chase.reason.chased_recently.nl: al herinnerd in de afgelopen 24 uur
client.todo.chase.reason.chased_recently.en: already reminded in the last 24 hours

client.todo.chase.reason.no_recipient.en: no one to send it to

client.todo.row.chased_days_ago.note: Compact, as the worklist's other row lines ('23 d').

client.todo.views.title.note: FR-FRM-000b: the caller's own saved worklist queries, in the rail's Firm area.

client.todo.views.count_unavailable.note: Instead of a count, when the view's stored query no longer validates (ADR-115).

client.todo.views.save_hint.nl: Bewaart het tabblad, de filters en de sortering die u nu ziet. Alleen u ziet uw weergaven.
client.todo.views.save_hint.en: Keeps the tab, filters and sort on screen now. Only you see your views.

client.todo.views.manage_hint.nl: Archiveren haalt de weergave uit uw lijst; aan uw klanten verandert niets.
client.todo.views.manage_hint.en: Archiving takes the view off your list; nothing changes for your clients.

client.todo.next.button.note: Client header, inside a client opened from To do: moves to the next client in the same worklist query.

client.todo.next.short.note: The same control on a phone, where the header has little room.

client.todo.next.done.nl: Geen klanten met werk meer in deze lijst.
client.todo.next.done.en: No more clients with work in this list.

client.rules.nav.note: Rail entry (Firm area) while a client is open: that client's approval rules and receipt reminders.

client.rules.context.nl: Wat er voor deze klant gebeurt zonder dat iemand klikt
client.rules.context.en: What happens for this client without anyone clicking

client.rules.chase.intro.nl: Staat dit aan, dan krijgt deze klant een e-mail met het aantal bankbetalingen waarvoor nog een bon nodig is, met een link naar de lijst. Nooit vaker dan één keer per periode, en het stopt zodra er niets meer ontbreekt.
client.rules.chase.intro.en: When on, this client gets an e-mail saying how many bank payments still need a receipt, with a link to the list. Never more than once per period, and it stops when nothing is missing.

client.rules.chase.enabled.en: Send receipt reminders to this client

client.rules.list.intro.note: Contract-wave2 decision 2: a rule only auto-approves what would already be a certain proposal against a document.
client.rules.list.intro.nl: Een regel boekt een zekere match van een bankbetaling met een bestaande bon of factuur van één leverancier op één grootboekrekening, zonder te vragen. Zonder document boekt een regel nooit. Boven het maximum wacht een match zoals gewoonlijk op beoordeling.
client.rules.list.intro.en: A rule books a certain match of a bank payment to an existing receipt or invoice from one supplier to one account, without asking. It never books without a document. Above the maximum, a match waits for review as usual.

client.rules.list.empty_body.nl: Vink „Dit voortaan altijd doen bij deze klanten” aan bij het goedkeuren van boekingsvoorstellen op Te doen om er een te maken.
client.rules.list.empty_body.en: To make one, tick “Always do this for these clients” when approving booking proposals on To do.

client.rules.status.suspended.note: The rule's maker no longer holds the right to reconcile here (decision 3); matches wait for review.

client.rules.max_hint.nl: Matches boven dit bedrag wachten op beoordeling.
client.rules.max_hint.en: Matches above this amount wait for review.

client.rules.retire_confirm.nl: De regel voor {counterparty} intrekken? Wat de regel al boekte, blijft staan; nieuwe matches wachten weer op beoordeling.
client.rules.retire_confirm.en: Retire the rule for {counterparty}? What it already booked stays as it is; new matches wait for review again.

client.rules.postings.intro.note: FR-GL-003: undo reverses through the bank path; a posting is never deleted.
client.rules.postings.intro.nl: Elke boeking die een regel voor deze klant maakte. Ongedaan maken zet de bankbetaling terug om opnieuw te koppelen; niets wat geboekt is, wordt ooit verwijderd.
client.rules.postings.intro.en: Every booking a rule made for this client. Undo puts the bank payment back to be matched again; nothing posted is ever deleted.

client.rules.postings.empty.nl: Nog niets geboekt door een regel.
client.rules.postings.empty.en: No rule has booked anything yet.

client.rules.postings.undo_confirm.nl: Deze boeking ongedaan maken? De bankbetaling gaat terug naar de lijst om te koppelen.
client.rules.postings.undo_confirm.en: Undo this booking? The bank payment goes back to the list to be matched.

client.rules.postings.not_undoable.nl: Kan hier niet meer ongedaan worden gemaakt.
client.rules.postings.not_undoable.en: Can no longer be undone here.
